answer_4.quote: To compare the performance of AI models and human performance on escape room games, we conducted a human study. We recruited a total of 20 participants, including both individuals familiar and those unfamiliar with escape room games, and each was instructed to complete tasks in four different rooms.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were instructed to complete tasks in four different rooms and their success rate, goal completion, number of steps, and time duration were recorded.
